description: Rust/WGPU Minecraft mipmap optimization; Sodium addon, Vulkan integration, and profiled Rust hot paths

mods.name: Fe2O3_nH2O
mods.description: Experimental Rust/WGPU Minecraft mipmap optimization. Sodium addon and Vulkan integration are planned, not yet implemented.

releases.notes:
Experimental prerelease for Minecraft Java 26.2 on Fabric.

This build accelerates only eligible MEAN texture mipmap generation. It does not replace world drawing and does not claim complete vanilla or resource-pack parity or an FPS improvement. See README.md and docs/RELEASES.md before installing.

Sodium 0.9.2 is co-loaded in the client smoke test. Fe2O3 remains a standalone Fabric mod: Sodium addon integration, minimap optimization, and replacement of Sodium rendering hot paths are not implemented. Co-loading is not a general Sodium/addon compatibility guarantee.

CI verified the tagged source with the repository’s four-target native build, mandatory software-Vulkan differential tests, packaged JAR checks and live client smoke test. The software Vulkan result is not a physical-GPU performance benchmark.

Source commit: 7f6f3df0e9bf77cf05c334f1a21daf4c31910f00
